name: Jewel Legend
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Legend is a free match-three game. Some legends are born, they come into this world with everything they need to be the superstar they become. But most legends are made, forged in the fires of discipline, hammered into shape by practice, and quenched in the healing waters of experience. You can be such a legend. You can step up to the plate and knock it out of the galaxy with our new match-three game: Jewel Legend. Jewel Legend demands concentration, pattern recognition, and a quick slip of the hand if one wants to win. In this fast-paced jewel game, you'll be tasked with matching three different jewels and unlocking new and exciting levels as you go. Make judicious use of power-ups, strategize the use of the different special abilities and you'll become the ultimate Jewel Legend. The rules are simple, line up at least three of a kind jewels, do it fast, and make the connections either horizontally or vertically but never diagonally. Try and line up trinities that will cause further jewels to line up after the initial boom and you got yourself combo train going! Jump on and wave goodbye to the normies. You're a legend now.
